authority_note: This protocol describes the live user-approved scope. File creation and hashes do not independently create human authority; external pins and independent admission review remain required.
controller_scope: The model classifies typed intent; a fixed symbolic controller plans the next step and Godot owns state commits. Enabled next action is exposed in both renderings. Negotiation opens dialogue through an identical authored player intervention.
limitations: One authored quest, two fresh repeats per cell, eight episodes total; no population generalization, causal efficacy, non-inferiority or equivalent compute.
Requested selector and medium settings are not attestation of serving identity, effective effort or model revision.
Provider-internal request count, actual credit debit and invoice cost remain unknown unless directly exposed.
No outcome-dependent retries, extra rows, replacement models, post-observation prompt edits or removal of failed assignments.
